title: eludite.git.commit input
description: Commit (Git Changes: Commit Staged, Commit All, Commit All and Push via eludite.git.push after it; Amend): the index becomes a commit on the current branch with `message`. The identity is `user.name` and `user.email` from the repository's config, then the global config (`~/.gitconfig`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/config`), then the settings git.userName and git.userEmail; with none the command is refused naming `git config user.name` and the settings. During a merge the commit gets the merged commit as its second parent; during a cherry-pick it completes the pick. Commits are not signed (git.gpgSign). Refused with nothing to commit (unless `amend`) and while files are conflicted. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: With `amend`: dangerous for an agent when the solution's policy sets `git.history` to `prompt` (the default), refused when `deny`. Otherwise dangerous when `git.commit` is `prompt`, refused when `deny`.

message.description: The commit message (its first line is the summary).

all.description: Commit All: stage every change of tracked and untracked files first. Default false.

amend.description: Replace the branch's last commit (Amend): history class for agents.

author.description: The author, when it is not the committer identity.
